summary: Search for a file path matching the input string. Prepends the backslash character to the search string, toggles a global buffer selector, calls sub_587C20 to locate the path, and on success extracts the filename portion (characters after the last backslash) from the located string into one of two alternating file-path buffers.

If sub_587C20 returned zero (not found), skip extraction and return null.
